name: How long does it take to complete an accessible bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete an accessible bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an accessible bathroom renovation depends on the extent of the modifications. Simple installations like grab bars might take a day or two, while a complete gut and remodel with structural changes can take several weeks, sometimes longer. Factors such as material availability, inspection schedules, and the complexity of plumbing or electrical work can influence the duration. We work to provide a clear project timeline upfront, managing expectations for clients throughout Berkeley and Oakland.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation timelines vary from days for minor installations to several weeks for full remodels, depending on scope and complexity.
